S.FORM: 'Moldova hya' ga cyux maki' tay 47 00 N, 29 00 E na Oco syuw. kwara' kinghciyan niya' 33,851 sq km (maki' tay 140ginkgan kin wahci') (kinwhci' niya' ga 32,891 sq km , kinwhci' na lawsayan wsilung hya' ga 960 sq km) Kinkhmayan kwara' squliq hya' ga 3,510,485. Pinbcyan naha' sni' naha' rhzyal hya' iy pqmahun hya' ga 74.90% , lhlahuy hya' ga 11.90%, sni' naha' sa pptzyuwaw sa bzinah hya' ga 13.20%. spzyang qalang na Kokka' spzyang naha' krahu' qalang hya' ga Chisinau. snyan kinramat inlungan na Kokka' snyan kinramat inlungan na Kokka' hya' ga 27 na tay mspat byacing na qutux kawas. mrhuw Kokka' mrhuw Kokka' ta' misuw hya' ga Igor Dodon, aring ryax 23 squ byacing tay 12 sa kawas 2016 lga, musa' spazyang balay ms'rux kya la. cinkhulan sa knita' sa brbiru' CIA 外交部
